⚠ Danger Zone — Test Data Cleanup

Use these tools to remove seeded / test data before going live. Each action is permanent — back up anything you need first.

Sales Orders & Work Orders

Deletes all SOs with status Cancelled, or all test/Shopify-simulated orders. Also deletes linked WOs.

All Orders & Work Orders

Nuclear option — wipes all sales orders, work orders, their line items, and any purchase orders linked to them. Inventory is NOT touched.

All Purchase Orders

Nuclear option — wipes all purchase orders and their line items. Any sales order items that were Ordered/Committed through one of these POs will revert to Available. Inventory quantities already received are NOT rolled back.

Fix Orphaned Line Items & POs

An earlier version of "Wipe ALL Orders" deleted orders but left their line items and linked purchase orders behind. New orders can then silently reuse those old order numbers and inherit that leftover history (showing up as extra items, already marked Committed). This finds and removes anything still referencing an order that no longer exists.

Remove Demo Placeholder Items

Deletes leftover setup/demo inventory rows (SUPPLY-LASER, BLK-SM, BLK-MD, BLK-LG, BLK-24) that aren't real items.

Remove Demo Products & Fake Orders

A leftover testing button (now removed) could create fake orders using placeholder products PM-SML / PM-MED / PM-LRG / PM-PRE with a customer name ending in "(Shopify)". This deletes those demo products and any order that used one.

Reset Stocking Level Test Data

Zeroes out Stocking Level, On Hand, and Reorder Point on every product, plus Reorder Point on every raw-material inventory row. Use this to clear out placeholder numbers entered while testing before setting real stocking levels. Does not delete any items.

SQL: Manual Cleanup

Copy this SQL to run directly in Supabase for full manual control.

This is your receiving address in Minnesota — it prints as the Ship To on every Purchase Order, since vendors now ship to you rather than drop-shipping to customers. Saved locally on this device/browser.
